key_finding: Best strategy: S3_mom (INDPRO 1-month momentum) / T1_fixed_p50 / P1_long_cash (pro-cyclical) / L11. OOS Sharpe 1.3282 vs 0.7437 B&H. Max drawdown -6.3%. Beats B&H on BOTH return (2.12x vs 1.85x) and risk. NOTE: pro-cyclical Long/Cash winner supersedes the prior countercyclical long/short acceleration winner (ECON-LT1 re-run, fix260620_lead_horizon).
mechanism: Rising industrial production signals economic expansion and improving corporate earnings. The winning strategy is pro-cyclical Long/Cash: it holds XLP when the 11-month-lagged INDPRO 1-month momentum is above its in-sample median and moves to cash otherwise. Although consumer staples are classically defensive, over this sample staying long XLP through the early-to-mid phase of IP expansions (and stepping aside when momentum rolls over) captured the sector's compounding while sidestepping the worst contraction drawdowns — beating buy-and-hold on both return and risk.
caveats: INDPRO is released with ~6-week publication lag — real-time trading must account for delay
COVID-19 April 2020 outlier (-12.7% MoM) may distort regime estimates
Consumer staples are defensive but not perfectly countercyclical — earnings quality matters
Monthly frequency limits signal granularity for daily strategies
XLP sample starts 1998 — shorter history than INDPRO (1919)
